findings.desc: In PDAPP mice expressing human apoE isoforms, clearance of endogenous soluble Aβ from hippocampal interstitial fluid was slowest with apoE4: ISF Aβ half-life was 1.1 hours in PDAPP/E4 mice versus 0.71 hours (E3) and 0.56 hours (E2), measured by in vivo microdialysis after halting Aβ production.
findings.quote: the half-life (t1/2) of ISF Aβ in the hippocampus of PDAPP/E4 mice was 1.1 hours, compared to 0.71 and 0.56 hours, measured from PDAPP/E3 and PDAPP/E2 mice, respectively
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (slower clearance of soluble Aβ from brain interstitial fluid; ISF Aβ half-life 1.1 h vs 0.71 h)
findings.exp_system: In vivo microdialysis in PDAPP/TRE mice expressing human apoE2, apoE3 or apoE4; hippocampal ISF Aβ elimination kinetics after gamma-secretase inhibition

findings.desc: Aged PDAPP/E4 mice accumulated far more hippocampal Aβ than E3 or E2 mice: Aβ burden at 20-21 months was approximately 2-fold higher than in PDAPP/E3 and 4.6-fold higher than in PDAPP/E2 mice.
findings.quote: Quantification revealed that hippocampal Aβ burden in 20- to 21-month-old PDAPP/E4 mice was approximately 2-fold and 4.6-fold higher than in PDAPP/E3 and PDAPP/E2 mice, respectively
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (greater hippocampal Aβ deposition with age)
findings.exp_system: PDAPP/TRE mice expressing human apoE isoforms; anti-Aβ (3D6) immunostaining and quantification of hippocampal Aβ burden at 20-21 months

findings.desc: CONTRADICTING: Aβ synthesis did not differ by apoE isoform: amyloidogenic APP processing and Aβ synthesis rates, measured by in vivo stable isotopic labeling kinetics in young PDAPP/TRE mice, were the same for apoE2, apoE3 and apoE4, indicating the isoform effect acts through clearance rather than production in this model.
findings.quote: amyloidogenic processing of amyloid precursor protein and Aβ synthesis, as assessed by in vivo stable isotopic labeling kinetics, do not vary according to apoE isoform in young PDAPP/TRE mice
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (no change in Aβ synthesis rate) [CONTRADICTS]
findings.exp_system: Young PDAPP/TRE mice expressing human apoE isoforms; in vivo stable isotopic labeling kinetics of Aβ synthesis

findings.desc: Glia-secreted apoE stimulated Aβ production by human neurons with a strict isoform potency order, apoE4 strongest: ApoE4 > ApoE3 > ApoE2 for neuronal Aβ production in ES-cell-derived human neurons.
findings.quote: Using ES-cell-derived human neurons, we show that ApoE secreted by glia stimulates neuronal Aβ production with an ApoE4 > ApoE3 > ApoE2 potency rank order
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (more neuronal Aβ production)
findings.exp_system: Human ES-cell-derived neurons exposed to glia-secreted apoE isoforms; Aβ40/Aβ42 measured in medium

findings.desc: The mechanism is transcriptional: apoE-receptor binding activates a DLK-MKK7-ERK1/2 cascade that phosphorylates cFos, activates AP-1 and increases APP transcription, raising Aβ levels; the same pathway regulates APP transcription in mouse brain in vivo.
findings.quote: Activated ERK1/2 induces cFos phosphorylation, stimulating the transcription factor AP-1, which in turn enhances transcription of amyloid-β precursor protein (APP) and thereby increases amyloid-β levels
findings.summary: (APOE4 binding to apoE receptors) -> (DLK/MKK7/ERK1/2-AP-1 activation) -> (more APP transcription) -> (more Aβ production)
findings.exp_system: Human ES-cell-derived neurons and mouse brain in vivo; kinase cascade and APP transcription readouts

findings.desc: ApoE4 disrupted Aβ clearance across the mouse blood-brain barrier more than apoE3 or apoE2: Aβ-apoE4 complexes were redirected from rapid LRP1 transport to slower VLDLR internalization. Only 12% of Aβ42 complexed with lipid-poor apoE4 was cleared at the BBB, versus 25% with apoE2 and 38% for free Aβ42.
findings.quote: only 25% and 12% of Aβ42 was cleared via lipid-poor apoE2 and apoE4, respectively, whereas 9% and 3% of Aβ42 was cleared by lipo-apoE2 and lipo-apoE4, respectively, compared with 38% as seen for free unbound Aβ42
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (Aβ-apoE complexes rerouted from LRP1 to slower VLDLR transport) -> (less Aβ clearance across the blood-brain barrier)
findings.exp_system: In vivo mouse brain microinfusion of radiolabeled Aβ40/42 free or complexed with human apoE isoforms; BBB efflux measured in wild-type, LRP1- and VLDLR-manipulated mice

findings.desc: Isogenic human APOE4 neurons secreted more Aβ42 than APOE3 neurons: CRISPR-edited iPSC-derived neurons homozygous for APOE4 showed elevated Aβ42 secretion relative to isogenic APOE3 cells.
findings.quote: APOE4 neurons exhibited increased synapse number and elevated Aβ42 secretion relative to isogenic APOE3 cells
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (more neuronal Aβ42 secretion)
findings.exp_system: Human iPSC-derived neurons, isogenic APOE3/3 vs APOE4/4 (CRISPR/Cas9-edited); Aβ42 secretion measured

findings.desc: APOE4 astrocytes were impaired at clearing Aβ: isogenic APOE4 astrocytes showed impaired Aβ uptake compared with APOE3 astrocytes, together with cholesterol accumulation.
findings.quote: APOE4 astrocytes displayed impaired Aβ uptake and cholesterol accumulation
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (less astrocytic Aβ uptake/clearance)
findings.exp_system: Human iPSC-derived astrocytes, isogenic APOE3 vs APOE4; Aβ uptake assay

findings.desc: APOE4 microglia-like cells phagocytosed less Aβ: APOE4 microglia-like cells had altered morphology that correlated with reduced Aβ phagocytosis relative to APOE3 cells.
findings.quote: APOE4 microglia-like cells exhibited altered morphologies, which correlated with reduced Aβ phagocytosis
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (less microglial Aβ phagocytosis/clearance)
findings.exp_system: Human iPSC-derived microglia-like cells, isogenic APOE3 vs APOE4; Aβ phagocytosis assay

findings.desc: Human iPSC-derived neurons expressing apoE4 produced more Aβ than apoE3-expressing neurons, and converting apoE4 to apoE3 by gene editing rescued the phenotype, showing a specific gain of toxic apoE4 effect on Aβ production in human neurons.
findings.quote: ApoE4 increased Aβ production in human, but not in mouse, neurons
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (more Aβ production by human neurons)
findings.exp_system: Human iPSC-derived neurons (apoE4/4 vs apoE3/3, including gene-edited isogenic lines); Aβ40/Aβ42 in culture medium by MSD/ELISA

findings.desc: Introducing apoE4 into apoE-null human neurons recapitulated the increased Aβ production: apoE-null neurons transduced with apoE4 produced more Aβ40 and Aβ42 than those expressing apoE3, and an apoE4 structure corrector reduced Aβ production/secretion dose-dependently.
findings.quote: We found that apoE4 specifically induces AD-related pathologies, including the increase in apoE fragmentation, tau phosphorylation, and Aβ production, as well as the degeneration/loss of GABAergic neurons
findings.summary: (no apoE -> APOE4 expression) -> (more Aβ40 and Aβ42 production)
findings.exp_system: APOE-knockout human iPSC-derived neurons with lentiviral apoE3 or apoE4 expression; Aβ40/Aβ42 in medium (Fig. 5o-p); structure-corrector PH002 treatment arm

findings.desc: CONTRADICTING: In mouse neurons the isoform effect on Aβ production was absent: mouse iPSC-derived neurons from human apoE3- and apoE4-knock-in mice showed no significant difference in Aβ40 or Aβ42 levels in culture medium, indicating the production effect is human-neuron-specific in this study.
findings.quote: there were no significant differences in both Aβ 40 and Aβ 42 levels in the culture medium of neurons derived from apoE3/3-miPSC and apoE4/4-miPSC lines
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (no change in Aβ production by mouse neurons) [CONTRADICTS]
findings.exp_system: Mouse iPSC-derived neurons from human apoE3-KI and apoE4-KI mouse fibroblasts; Aβ40/Aβ42 in culture medium

findings.desc: ApoE promotes proteolytic degradation of soluble Aβ by microglia (neprilysin-mediated) and extracellularly by insulin-degrading enzyme, but apoE4 is the least efficient isoform: apoE2 showed the strongest promotion of Aβ degradation and apoE4 was significantly less efficient, so APOE4 supports less proteolytic Aβ clearance.
findings.quote: While all isoforms of human ApoE increased clearance of soluble Aβ, ApoE2 exhibited the strongest effect whereas ApoE4 was significantly less efficient in promoting the degradation of soluble Aβ
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (less apoE-promoted proteolytic degradation of soluble Aβ by microglia)
findings.exp_system: Primary microglia from Apoe-knockout mice treated with soluble Aβ42 plus purified human apoE2/E3/E4 HDL particles from targeted-replacement astrocytes; Aβ degradation measured

findings.desc: Despite minimal direct binding, apoE isoforms regulate soluble Aβ metabolism: apoE and sAβ compete for LRP1-dependent cellular uptake in astrocytes, and apoE isoforms regulated sAβ metabolism in astrocytes and in mouse brain interstitial fluid during apoE-infusion microdialysis, providing a clearance mechanism by which isoforms change Aβ levels.
findings.quote: we find that apoE isoforms regulate the metabolism of sAβ by astrocytes and in the interstitial fluid of mice that received apoE infusions during brain Aβ microdialysis
findings.summary: (APOE isoform) -> (competition for LRP1-dependent astrocyte uptake) -> (isoform-dependent soluble Aβ clearance)
findings.exp_system: Cultured astrocytes and in vivo mouse brain microdialysis with apoE isoform infusions; sAβ uptake/metabolism and LRP1 competition assays

findings.desc: Direct apoE-sAβ binding in physiological fluids is minimal: apoE and soluble Aβ interactions occurred minimally in solution and in human cerebrospinal fluid for both apoE3 and apoE4, arguing against a direct-binding explanation of isoform effects on Aβ load.
findings.quote: apoE and sAβ interactions occur minimally in solution and in the cerebrospinal fluid of human subjects
findings.summary: (APOE isoform) -> (minimal direct apoE-sAβ association in solution/CSF; load effects act via receptors/cell surfaces instead)
findings.exp_system: Biochemical and analytical binding assays with apoE3/apoE4 and soluble Aβ in solution and human CSF

findings.desc: Blood-brain barrier pericytes clear aggregated Aβ42 by an LRP1-dependent, apoE isoform-specific mechanism, and apoE4 fails to support it: human astrocyte-derived lipidated apoE3, but not apoE4, normalized Aβ42 clearance by mouse pericytes whose endogenous apoE was silenced.
findings.quote: Human astrocyte-derived lipidated apoE3, but not apoE4, normalized Aβ42 clearance by mouse pericytes with silenced mouse ApoE
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (pericyte LRP1-mediated clearance of aggregated Aβ42 not supported) -> (less Aβ clearance at the blood-brain barrier)
findings.exp_system: Mouse brain capillary pericytes on brain slices and multi-spot slides, endogenous Apoe silenced, with human astrocyte-derived lipidated apoE3 or apoE4; Cy3-Aβ42 uptake/clearance with LRP1 inhibition

findings.desc: ApoE4 produced far more fibrillar amyloid deposition than apoE3 in vivo: APP(V717F) transgenic, apoE-knockout mice expressing human apoE3 or apoE4 developed fibrillar Aβ deposits and neuritic plaques by 15 months, with substantially (>10-fold) more fibrillar deposits in apoE4-expressing mice.
findings.quote: substantially (>10-fold) more fibrillar deposits were observed in apoE4-expressing APP(V717F) TG mice
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (>10-fold more fibrillar Aβ deposition and neuritic plaques)
findings.exp_system: APP(V717F) transgenic mice on apoE-knockout background expressing human apoE3 or apoE4; thioflavine-S fibrillar Aβ deposits at 15 months

findings.desc: Brain Aβ levels were strongly apoE isoform-dependent in PDAPP mice expressing human apoE, in the order E4 >> E3 > E2: brain Aβ42 was substantially elevated in young PDAPP/TRE4 mice even before deposition began, and the isoform effect on brain Aβ burden increased with age.
findings.quote: resulting in early and dramatic apoE isoform-dependent effects on brain Abeta levels (E4 >> E3 > E2) that increase with age
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (higher brain Aβ42 levels and Aβ burden, E4 >> E3 > E2)
findings.exp_system: PDAPP mice crossed with human apoE targeted-replacement mice (TRE2/TRE3/TRE4); Aβ peptides in brain homogenates, CSF and plasma across ages; amyloid burden at 18 months

findings.desc: In EFAD transgenic mice (5xFAD crossed with apoE targeted-replacement mice), soluble Aβ42 and oligomeric Aβ levels were highest with APOE4, and E4FAD mice developed more compact plaques and higher total Aβ than E2FAD/E3FAD mice, despite comparable soluble apoE levels across isoforms.
findings.quote: Soluble Aβ42 and oAβ levels were highest in E4FAD mice, although soluble apoE2, apoE3, and apoE4 levels were comparable
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (highest soluble Aβ42 and oligomeric Aβ; more compact plaque deposition)
findings.exp_system: EFAD mice (5xFAD x apoE2/E3/E4 targeted replacement), 2-6 months; sequential TBS/detergent/formic-acid extraction of brain Aβ, soluble Aβ42 and oligomeric Aβ assays, plaque morphology

findings.desc: Human apoE4 directed amyloid into cerebral vessel walls: at 15 months, Tg2576 mice expressing human apoE4 developed substantial cerebral amyloid angiopathy with very few parenchymal plaques, whereas apoE3-expressing mice had almost no CAA or plaques; young apoE4 mice also showed an elevated brain extracellular Aβ40:42 ratio, consistent with altered Aβ clearance/transport.
findings.quote: At 15 months of age, the expression of human apoE4 led to substantial CAA with very few parenchymal plaques, whereas the expression of human apoE3 resulted in almost no CAA or parenchymal plaques
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (substantial cerebral amyloid angiopathy; altered Aβ40:42 compartment ratios)
findings.exp_system: Tg2576 APP transgenic mice bred to human APOE3 or APOE4 knock-in mice; CAA and parenchymal plaque histology at 15 months; Aβ40:42 ratios in brain extracellular pools and CSF

findings.desc: ApoE4 enhanced Aβ production in neuronal cells more than apoE3: lipid-poor apoE4 increased Aβ production by 60% in APP-expressing B103 neuroblastoma cells versus 30% for apoE3, through stronger stimulation of APP recycling via the LRP pathway and apoE4 domain interaction.
findings.quote: Lipid-poor apoE4 increased Abeta production in B103-APP cells to a greater extent than lipid-poor apoE3 (60% vs. 30%) due to more pronounced stimulation of APP recycling by apoE4 than apoE3
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (more APP recycling) -> (more Aβ production, +60% vs +30%)
findings.exp_system: Rat neuroblastoma B103 cells stably transfected with human APP695, treated with lipid-poor apoE3 or apoE4; Aβ production measured, with LRP blockade (RAP/siRNA) controls

findings.desc: Reducing apoE before plaques form strongly reduced Aβ pathology in APOE4 (and APOE3) amyloid mice: antisense-oligonucleotide reduction of apoE in APP/PS1-21 mice homozygous for APOE-e4 or APOE-e3, started after birth, significantly decreased Aβ pathology at 4 months, showing apoE (including apoE4) is required for initiation of Aβ deposition.
findings.quote: ASO treatment starting after birth led to a significant decrease in Aβ pathology when assessed at 4 months
findings.summary: (apoE reduction by ASO in APOE4 mice) -> (less initiation of Aβ pathology)
findings.exp_system: APP/PS1-21 mice homozygous for human APOE-e4 or APOE-e3; antisense oligonucleotide lowering of brain apoE from birth; Aβ pathology at 4 months

findings.desc: CONTRADICTING: Once deposition had begun, lowering apoE did not reduce overall plaque load: ASO treatment started at the onset of amyloid deposition increased Aβ plaque size and reduced plaque-associated neuritic dystrophy but produced no change in overall plaque load.
findings.quote: ASO treatment starting at the onset of amyloid deposition led to an increase in Aβ plaque size and a reduction in plaque-associated neuritic dystrophy with no change in overall plaque load
findings.summary: (apoE reduction after Aβ seeding) -> (no change in overall plaque load) [CONTRADICTS]
findings.exp_system: APP/PS1-21 APOE-e4/e3 mice; antisense oligonucleotide lowering of apoE started at onset of amyloid deposition; plaque load and plaque size quantified

findings.desc: Microglial APOE4 impairs the response to amyloid pathology: deleting APOE4 specifically from microglia restored the neurodegeneration-associated microglial (MGnD) phenotype and decreased pathology in APP/PS1 mice, and deleting the APOE4-induced checkpoint Inpp5d restored microglia-astrocyte cross-talk (LGALS3-mediated plaque encapsulation) and facilitated plaque clearance.
findings.quote: Deletion of microglial APOE4 restores the MGnD phenotype associated with neuroprotection in P301S tau transgenic mice and decreases pathology in APP/PS1 mice
findings.summary: (microglial APOE4 present -> deleted) -> (restored microglial response, more plaque encapsulation/clearance, less Aβ pathology)
findings.exp_system: Mice with microglia-specific APOE4 deletion on APP/PS1 (and P301S) backgrounds; Aβ pathology and plaque clearance readouts; ITGB8-TGFβ/Inpp5d pathway manipulation

findings.desc: ApoE increased Aβ oligomer formation isoform-dependently, with apoE4 strongest: using synthetic Aβ and a split-luciferase oligomer assay, apoE raised Aβ oligomer levels in the order E2 < E3 < E4, an effect dependent on the apoE C-terminal domain and confirmed with endogenous human-brain apoE.
findings.quote: we observed that apoE increased the level of Aβ oligomers in an isoform-dependent manner (E2 < E3 < E4)
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (more Aβ oligomer formation)
findings.exp_system: In vitro Aβ oligomerization assays (synthetic Aβ, split-luciferase complementation) with lipidated apoE2/E3/E4 and endogenous apoE from human brain TBS-soluble fraction

findings.desc: Human AD brains carrying APOE e4/e4 had 2.7 times more Aβ oligomers than e3/e3 brains matched for total plaque burden, indicating apoE4 raises the oligomeric (synaptotoxic) Aβ pool independently of plaque load.
findings.quote: the level of Aβ oligomers in APOE ε4/ε4 AD patient brains is 2.7 times higher than those in APOE ε3/ε3 AD patient brains, matched for total plaque burden
findings.summary: (APOE3/3 -> APOE4/4 genotype) -> (2.7x more Aβ oligomers in AD brain at equal plaque burden)
findings.exp_system: Postmortem AD patient brains, APOE e4/e4 vs e3/e3 matched for plaque burden; Aβ oligomer levels in TBS-soluble fraction

findings.desc: ApoE4 directs oligomeric Aβ to synapses: in mouse primary neuronal culture, lipidated apoE4 enhanced oligomeric Aβ association with synapses via apoE receptors, and apoE4 protein colocalized with oligomeric Aβ and enhanced its synaptic localization by >5-fold in AD brain, linking APOE4 to greater synaptotoxic Aβ load at synapses.
findings.quote: In mouse primary neuronal culture, lipidated apolipoprotein E4 enhances oligomeric amyloid-β association with synapses via a mechanism involving apolipoprotein E receptors
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (more oligomeric Aβ localized to synapses)
findings.exp_system: Mouse primary neuronal cultures with lipidated apoE4; oligomeric Aβ synaptic association assay; array tomography of human AD brain synapses by APOE genotype

findings.desc: APOE4 exacerbated pollutant-induced cerebral amyloid: female EFAD mice (5xFAD with human APOE e3 or e4) exposed to nanosized particulate matter for 225 hours over 15 weeks showed increased cerebral β-amyloid (thioflavin S and Aβ immunostaining), and the increase was exacerbated by APOE e4, with increased Aβ oligomers.
findings.quote: showed increased cerebral β-amyloid by thioflavin S for fibrillary amyloid and by immunocytochemistry for Aβ deposits, both exacerbated by APOE ɛ4
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4, under particulate-matter exposure) -> (more cerebral Aβ deposition and oligomers)
findings.exp_system: Female EFAD transgenic mice (5xFAD+/-, human APOE e3/e3 or e4/e4) exposed to urban nanosized particulate matter 225 h over 15 weeks; cerebral Aβ by thioflavin S and immunocytochemistry

findings.desc: ApoE4 bound synthetic amyloid beta peptide far faster than apoE3: both isoforms formed SDS-resistant complexes with beta/A4 peptide, but binding to apoE4 occurred within minutes whereas binding to apoE3 required hours, an isoform-specific interaction that could promote Aβ sequestration and deposition.
findings.quote: binding to apoE4 was observed in minutes, whereas binding to apoE3 required hours
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (much faster apoE-Aβ complex formation; Aβ sequestration)
findings.exp_system: In vitro binding assay: purified human apoE3/apoE4 with synthetic amyloid beta (beta/A4) peptide; SDS-resistant complex formation kinetics

findings.desc: ApoE4 associated with Aβ more efficiently than apoE3 and drove fibril formation: coincubation of Aβ(1-40) with apoE produced 7 nm monofibrils, with apoE4/Aβ coincubates yielding a denser monofibril matrix and monofibrils appearing earlier than with apoE3, consistent with apoE4 promoting amyloid fibrillogenesis.
findings.quote: ApoE4/A beta coincubates yielded a denser matrix of monofibrils than apoE3/A beta coincubates
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (faster, denser Aβ monofibril formation)
findings.exp_system: In vitro coincubation of synthetic Aβ(1-28)/Aβ(1-40) with apoE3, apoE4 or albumin at 37C; negative-stain electron microscopy and immunogold labeling

findings.desc: ApoE acted as a pathological chaperone for Aβ fibrillogenesis and apoE4 was the more efficient isoform: apoE increased both the rate and total amount of amyloid fibril formation by synthetic Aβ(1-40) in a thioflavine-T assay, and recombinant apoE4 enhanced amyloid formation more efficiently than apoE3.
findings.quote: When recombinant apoE isoforms were used, apoE4 was more efficient than apoE3 at enhancing amyloid formation
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (faster and greater Aβ fibril formation)
findings.exp_system: In vitro fibrillogenesis of synthetic Aβ(1-40) and analogues with recombinant apoE isoforms; thioflavine-T fluorescence, electron microscopy, Congo Red

findings.desc: Apolipoprotein E, and apoE4 in particular, accelerated Aβ fibril formation in vitro: with electron microscopy and a thioflavin T assay, apoE enhanced the spontaneous fibrillogenesis of Aβ peptides, with the apoE4 isoform the most effective, suggesting apoE4 accelerates amyloid formation.
findings.quote: we found that apo E and apo E4 in particular enhance this spontaneous fibrillogenesis of A beta peptides under the in vitro conditions used
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (accelerated Aβ fibrillogenesis)
findings.exp_system: In vitro Aβ peptide fibrillogenesis with apoE isoforms; electron microscopy and thioflavin T fibril assay

findings.desc: ApoE is a kinetic (not thermodynamic) inhibitor of amyloid formation, and apoE4 is a slightly weaker inhibitor than apoE3: at physiological concentrations apoE delayed amyloid fibril nucleation (apoE3 at 40 nM, a 1:1000 apoE/beta-protein ratio), while apoE4 was equipotent or slightly less potent, so APOE4 homozygotes are proposed to have a reduced ability to suppress in vivo amyloid formation.
findings.quote: We propose that the linkage between the APOE4 allele and AD reflects the reduced ability of APOE4 homozygotes to suppress in vivo amyloid formation
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (slightly less kinetic inhibition of amyloid nucleation) -> (less suppression of amyloid formation)
findings.exp_system: In vitro amyloid formation kinetics of beta-amyloid protein (beta1-40) with apoE3/apoE4 and apoE fragments; nucleation lag and seeded growth assays

findings.desc: Lipidated apoE4 bound Aβ less avidly than lipidated apoE3: native lipid-associated apoE3 bound Aβ1-40 and Aβ1-42 with 2-3-fold higher affinity than apoE4 (delipidation abolished the difference), a binding disadvantage the authors link to less efficient apoE-mediated clearance/routing of Aβ out of the CNS for apoE4.
findings.quote: The data demonstrate that native lipid-associated apoE3 binds to Abeta peptides with 2-3-fold higher affinity than lipid-associated apoE4
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (lower-affinity apoE-Aβ binding when lipidated) -> (less apoE-mediated Aβ clearance/routing)
findings.exp_system: Solid-phase binding assay: native/delipidated/reconstituted-HDL apoE3 and apoE4 from transfected cells binding Aβ1-40/Aβ1-42; dissociation constants estimated
